pressureCategory: Mean-radius reference. Seasonal variation reported by NASA is 4.0–8.7 mbar.

radiationEnvironment: No global intrinsic magnetosphere and thin ~16 g/cm² CO₂ atmosphere; ~230 mSv/yr galactic cosmic ray surface dose (MSL RAD) plus acute solar particle events.
humanSafetyWarnings: Ambient pressure is below 62.8 mbar, the Armstrong limit.
Oxygen partial pressure at this reference is approximately 0.001 kPa.
sourceCitation: NASA NSSDCA Mars Fact Sheet + MSL Curiosity REMS / RAD published reference data.
